sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def st10():
    a = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    return ''.join('1' if a[42][21+5*i]=='B' else '0' for i in range(5))+''.join('1' if a[45][21+5*i]=='B' else '0' for i in range(5))
cands = ['1111100000','0000011111','1010001010','0101010100','1010101010','0101010101',
'1100000111','0011111000','1110000011','0001111100','1000000001','0000110000',
'1111001111','0111111110','1010011111','1111110100','1010000000','0000010100',
'0101011111','1111101010','0011011100','1110000110','1101100100','0010011011',
'0011111111','1111100111','1001101100','0110010011','1011001001','0100110110',
'1111100110','0011011111','1111100100','0010011111']
todo = set(c for c in cands if c not in ('1010010100',))
n=0; cur=None
for _ in range(40):
    cur = st10()
    if not todo: break
    tgt = min(todo, key=lambda t: sum(a!=b for a,b in zip(t,cur)))
    diff = [j for j in range(10) if tgt[j]!=cur[j]]
    todo.discard(tgt)
    for j in diff:
        row, col = (42, 21+5*(j%5)) if j<5 else (45, 21+5*(j-5))
        action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':row,'col':col}])
        n+=1
        r = last_action_result
        st = st10()
        tl = sum(1 for c in range(64) if current_frame.ascii.split('\n')[1][c]=='b')
        print(n, st, "timer",tl, "over",r.get('game_over'),"done",r.get('done'))
        if r.get('game_over') or r.get('done') or r.get('run_complete'): break
        if tl<=1: break
    if r.get('game_over') or r.get('done') or r.get('run_complete') or tl<=1: break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
